liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Sugaree** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls this the best Sugaree they have heard from Dead and Company so far; Reviewer finds Sugaree especially jammed out, alongside Viola Lee Blues [6][8]
- **Althea** (1 review): Reviewer says John Mayer knows Althea thoroughly, playing it with total familiarity [11]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): Reviewer especially loves Oteil's contribution to Fire On The Mountain [6]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): Reviewer loves the crowd sing-along during He's Gone, which the recording captures [11]
- **Viola Lee Blues** (1 review): Reviewer finds Viola Lee Blues especially jammed out [8]

## Setlist highlights

- **Milestones**: rare: 14 archived performances [13]

## The recordings

- **DeadCo2017-11-17** (recommended): source not stated; 18 songs; 175 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [1]
- **deadandco2017-11-17.schoeps.fr2le.24bit**: source not stated; 18 songs; 176 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: Taper's rig sounds close to the stage, with audible crowd noise between songs, including a cough at the start; First set has some noise because the microphones were front-of-board before the rig was moved [2][9]
- **deadandcompany2017-11-17**: source not stated; 18 songs; 175 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the recording as crisp, thick and full [12]
- **deadandco2017-11-17.schoeps.fr2le.16bit**: source not stated; 18 songs; 176 min [4]. Said about its sound: First set has some noise because the mics were front-of-board before being moved [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer drove from Maine; a friend flew in from Colorado Springs; they sat in the upper-level seats [6]
- Security confronted the taper at the start, asking what the gear was; the taper's recording continued [9]
- Reviewer says it may be the best audience recording at the Garden in 30 years of bootleg listening [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **DeadCo2017-11-17**: taped by Jay; transferred by Jay; source: Schoeps MK4's>Schoeps CMR's>Naiant PFA>Edirol R-44 (OCM) [1]
- **deadandco2017-11-17.schoeps.fr2le.24bit**: taped by Dave Flaschner; transferred by Andy Murray; source: Schoeps mk4/mk41>Fostex FR2LE (24bit/48khz) [2]
- **deadandco2017-11-17.schoeps.fr2le.16bit**: taped by Dave Flaschner; transferred by Andy Murray; source: Schoeps mk4/mk41>Fostex FR2LE (24bit/48khz) [4]. Also: Schoeps mics into Fostex FR2LE, then Audacity, Soundforge resampling and dither to 16-bit/44.1k FLAC; seeded by Andy Murray [4]
